cards.mood: The piece opens with a majestic and solemn atmosphere, establishing a sense of historical grandeur.
cards.palette: A lush string ensemble serves as the primary harmonic bed throughout the track, shifting from slow, legato bowing in the intro to rapid, staccato ostinatos during the high-energy sections.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, mournful atmosphere that gradually builds tension through the addition of rhythmic elements and harmonic density.
cards.palette: A solo traditional bowed string instrument (resembling an Erhu) carries the main melodic motif from the Intro, weaving through the verses and returning prominently in the Outro.

cards.mood: The piece opens with a solitary, mournful atmosphere that evokes deep nostalgia and introspection.
cards.palette: A solo Erhu (Chinese two-stringed fiddle) serves as the primary melodic voice in the intro and verses, delivering a plaintive, singing tone.
